name: @futurx/puzzle-module-functions
description: Cloud Functions for the Puzzle Module — deployed as the 'puzzle-module' codebase into the dedicated lovedigitally-puzzle Firebase project (see ../firebase.json).

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions --project lovedigitally-puzzle
scripts.test:emulator: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --project lovedigitally-puzzle --only firestore,auth,storage "cd functions && npm run build && GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=.emulator-fixtures/fake-service-account.json jasmine --config=jasmine.emulator.json"
